A.name: Sootling
A.idea: Soot imp in profile: round goggled head under a cap, wide stance, ember tail; a scalloped bat wing flares ember orange; lime gas pods.

B.name: Hoodie Tom
B.idea: Alley cat in profile: tall ears through a teal hoodie, snout and eye to the right, upright curled tail; the hood cape flaps as the wing; magenta pods.

C.name: Lantern Moth
C.idea: Slim moth bearer in profile: antennae, big eye, narrow thorax on long thin legs, striped abdomen; one broad amber leaf wing with an eye-spot flaps; aqua pods.
